title: Madrid Residency Night 3 — Second Cluster Begins; 192,000+ Fans Across First Three Sold-Out Shows
detail: Bad Bunny performed the third night of his landmark 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid on June 2, 2026, before another sold-out crowd of approximately 64,000 — opening the second consecutive-night cluster (June 2–3) of the engagement. Through three nights, the residency has now drawn a cumulative 192,000+ fans, on pace toward the projected 640,000 total across all 10 shows (May 30–31 and June 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11, 14, 15), which would mark the largest single-artist concert run in Spanish history. The standard DtMF World Tour setlist opened with 'La Mudanza' and carried through the full album arc plus deep cuts from YHLQMDLG and El Último Tour del Mundo, with the stage's life-size sapo concho frog and 'La Casita' secondary platform central to the show's Puerto Rican visual identity. Each night of the residency has featured at least one exclusive element: Night 1 (May 30) brought the first-ever live collaboration between Bad Bunny and Myke Towers — joining for 'Adivino' and a multi-song medley; Night 2 (May 31) featured Dominican-American rapper Luar La L as a surprise guest, performing 'Teléfono Nuevo' from the 'La Casita' secondary platform. Night 3 coverage is still emerging, as the show concluded during local evening hours. Spanish economists have estimated the 10-night run will generate approximately €200 million in economic activity for the Madrid metropolitan area, with roughly 40% of attendees traveling from outside the city. The DtMF World Tour's European leg continues in Düsseldorf (June 20–21), Arnhem (June 23–24), London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (June 27–28) — Bad Bunny's first-ever UK stadium dates — and closes in Brussels on July 22, 2026.
